_template_note: MiniMax uses the Bifrost-owned process-attested loopback proxy. Do not add an Authorization header or store a virtual key in this file. MiniMax reads the MCP server timeout field in milliseconds, so timeout must be 300000 ms. The agent-turn tool discovery path caps HTTP connects at 2000 ms regardless of this value.
_cli_limitation: PATH wrappers mavis.cmd/minimax.cmd point at nonexistent resources/resources/daemon/cli.js on MiniMax Code 3.0.53.91 — CLI route unsupported; use in-app mcp.json only.
